scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @trailframe/api" "npm run dev -w @trailframe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trailframe/track-core && npm run build -w @trailframe/api && npm run build -w @trailframe/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trailframe/track-core && npm run test -w @trailframe/api && npm run test -w @trailframe/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trailframe/track-core && npm run typecheck -w @trailframe/api && npm run typecheck -w @trailframe/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
